SupplyChainNode.description:
One hop in the OpenRTB supply chain (``schain`` node).

Field names are the OpenRTB SupplyChainNode names verbatim. ``asi`` is
the advertising system identifier (the canonical domain of the system
the node operates in, e.g. ``"exchange.example.com"``); ``sid`` is the
seller id **within that system** and matches a ``seller_id`` in that
system's sellers.json.

asi.description: Advertising system identifier (canonical domain of the system).
asi.title: Asi

domain.description: Business domain of the entity represented by this node.
domain.title: Domain

hp.description: Handled-payment flag (OpenRTB 0/1): 1 = node is paid for this inventory.
hp.title: Hp

name.description: Business name of the entity represented by this node.
name.title: Name

rid.description: Request id issued by the seller (OpenRTB ``rid``), when present.
rid.title: Rid

sid.description: Seller id within the ``asi`` system; matches its sellers.json seller_id.
sid.title: Sid

SupplyChainNode.title: SupplyChainNode

description:
OpenRTB SupplyChain object (``schain``): the ordered node path.

``complete`` is the OpenRTB 0/1 flag: 1 means every node from the
initial impression to the final bidder is present (no undisclosed
hops). Nodes are ordered from the first seller to the entity making the
request. Carried optionally on the :class:`Deal` for transparency.

complete.description: OpenRTB 0/1: 1 = all nodes in the path are disclosed.
complete.title: Complete

title: SupplyChain
